summary: Specifies IANA parameter assignment considerations for DNS, covering resource record types, classes, opcodes, error codes, header bits and AFSDB subtypes. It obsoletes RFC 6195 and updates RFC 1183, RFC 2845, RFC 2930 and RFC 3597. It is a Best Current Practice.

eli5.summary: The rulebook for how new items get added to the official lists of DNS words, codes and labels.

questions: how are new dns record types registered
